tools.name: audit_website
tools.description: Run a Fukamo SEO and AI-readability audit on one public URL. Returns the score, how many checks failed, and the failing checks worst-first with a fix for each. Use it to find what to improve on a page, or to confirm a change actually fixed something.

url.description: Public URL of the page to audit, including https://

tools.name: fukamo_report_pdf
tools.description: Audit one public URL and save the full Fukamo report as a PDF file. Use it when someone asks for a report, a document or something to send on, rather than for findings to act on. Reports are limited to a quarter of the key quota, 15 an hour by default; on a 429, wait rather than retrying.

url.description: Public URL of the page to audit, including https://

path.description: Where to write the PDF, e.g. ./report.pdf

tools.name: audit_website_pages
tools.description: Run a Fukamo audit on up to 10 public URLs of the same website and wait for all of them. Returns each page with its score and failing checks. This takes minutes, not seconds — the pages are measured one at a time. Use it for "audit my site"; use audit_website for a single page.

urls.description: 1–10 public URLs of the same website, each including https://
